about: Inderal (propranolol, a non-selective beta-blocker) is supplied five times from April to September 2026 for a man aged 71, by brand name only.
Labetalol (Presolol, a beta-blocker on the list) is supplied three times in the middle of a 14-month history for a woman aged 73.
Tenormin (atenolol, a beta-blocker that acts mainly on the heart) is supplied monthly. It is not on the list, so nothing must flag.
